baseline-s4-idle.about: the frozen baseline page at Scardroy, main at 4c687c9 plus the uncommitted idle change; tools.site.baseline makes baseline-x, the frame-time and parity reference at X, from it
baseline-s4-idle.obtain: It is files/baseline-s4-idle.html in Copilot session 66bca34b-296f-4bbc-a31f-5f89354e4d00.

baseline-x.about: the frozen baseline page re-frozen at site X: baseline-s4-idle's renderer with its castle's window band, shading ramp and fog made relative to the lake, the page's colours for the surface classes X's data adds, X's build/data.js (sha256 6d2bc65009edb8e4...) in place of Scardroy's, and the trunk page's tour (its waypoints and path, about 574 s) in place of its own; the parity and frame-time reference at X
baseline-x.obtain: Run python -X utf8 -m tools.site.baseline in a worktree whose build/data.js has that sha256 and whose hogwarts-flyover.html flies that tour: it writes build/inputs/baseline-x.html, where tools.inputs finds it, and checks it against this pin.

data-before-railway.about: Scardroy's build/data.js as pack.py and fix_berth.py left it, before the railway regrade, from the original build; kept for the record, since S0 has started from data-before-railway-x since the move to X and nothing needs it
data-before-railway.obtain: It is files/data-before-railway.js in Copilot session 66bca34b-296f-4bbc-a31f-5f89354e4d00.

data-before-railway-x.about: site X's build/data.js as pack.py and fix_berth.py leave it, before the railway regrade; the input of stage S0
data-before-railway-x.obtain: Build it in this worktree: run `python -X utf8 -m tools.site.sources fetch`, then `python -X utf8 -m tools.site.build x`, which builds X's data from the pinned sources and writes this file to build/inputs/, where it is found. Don't record it in inputs.json, which every worktree shares.

original-intermediates.about: the original data build's inputs and intermediates: class rasters, castle masses, metadata and water layers, DEM and Sentinel-2 tiles, OSM extracts, the location searches and the original build scripts
original-intermediates.obtain: It is files/hogwarts in Copilot session dd39d8db-7f9d-4bc9-8a0d-c80aa8428778 (White Hound's pages there come from the White Hound cache instead).

whitehound-mirror.about: a local copy of White Hound's pages, text extracts, images and image index (hogwarts/raw, hogwarts/txt, hogwarts/img, hogwarts/legend, whref, whref-index.json), from which tools/whcache.py fills its cache; tools/whcache.lock.json pins every file
whitehound-mirror.obtain: It is the files folder of Copilot session 66bca34b-296f-4bbc-a31f-5f89354e4d00. Without it the cache fetches what it can from the web; the text extracts and the image index exist only in the mirror.

site-glo30.about: Copernicus GLO-30 surface-model tiles N57 W006 and W005, which cover every layer and horizon of both sites

site-os50.about: OS Terrain 50, Great Britain's 50 m bare-earth model (ASCII grids), OS's 2026-07 release
site-os50.obtain: Run `python -X utf8 -m tools.site.sources fetch site-os50` while OS still serves the 2026-07 release: its download API serves only the current release, which OS replaces each year. After that, use a kept copy of the pinned terr50_gagg_gb.zip and record its folder with `python -X utf8 -m tools.inputs set site-os50 FOLDER`. Re-pinning to a newer release changes the heights, so its registration and the model comparison must be measured again.

site-ostn15.about: the OSTN15 grid that transforms British National Grid coordinates to ETRS89

site-fabdem.about: FABDEM V1-2 tiles N57 W006 and W005: Copernicus GLO-30 with forests and buildings removed

site-gedtm30.about: GEDTM30 v1.2, a 30 m bare-earth ensemble model, over 57-58 N and 6-4 W in metres

site-osm-x.about: OpenStreetMap within 13 km of site X as of 2026-10-31: peaks and hills, places, water, watercourses, roads, railways, buildings and woods

site-osm-water-x.about: OpenStreetMap water bodies, riverbanks and coastline within 40 km of site X, and watercourses within 13 km, as of 2026-10-31

site-s2-x.about: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2023 tiles over site X: zoom 14 for the 12 km layer, zoom 11 for the 36 km layer
